{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue"}
